name: Christian Mother
source:
You play the rebellious stepson stuck in the house with your fire-and-brimstone pastor father and your sweet ,devoted... and ridiculously hot MOTHER.

Everything seems “normal” until your mother decides to drag you to a “special prayer therapy” to cast the devil out of you.

What begins as an awkward, tense session quickly spirals into the most unholy family counseling imaginable.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4144580/Christian_Mother/?curator_clanid=41316928]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名叛逆的继子，与动辄把地狱烈火挂在嘴边的牧师继父，以及温柔虔诚……却又性感得要命的母亲同困在一个屋檐下。

表面上一切似乎都很“正常”——直到母亲决定硬拉着你接受一场“特别祈祷疗法”，要把盘踞在你体内的恶魔驱逐出去。

起初尴尬而紧绷的辅导过程，很快便失控演变成了超乎想象、最渎神背德的家庭心理咨询。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4144580/Christian_Mother/?curator_clanid=41316928]Steam[/url]]
